text: Isolde Mournvale, also known as 'the Hollow Blade', has been a sworn member of the Ashen Order since 341 AS, serving under Commander Ederon Fellgard in the order's western chapter.

section: Military Campaigns — The War of Drowned Light
text: The Ashen Order emerged victorious in the War of Drowned Light in 358 AS, having broken the Riverlands' naval blockade at the Battle of Cinderreach.
They say the Gauntlet of Sorrowfell was forged in the winter of 312 AS, though old Harrow always claimed it was closer to 300, back before the Order even had a name.
Artifact: Gauntlet of Sorrowfell | Forged: 341 AS | Forgemaster: Kellan Ashgrove | Attunement cost: 3 shards of will
Ravena Stormwell had never doubted her order's cause, not even in the frozen months after Drowned Light, when half the western chapter still whispered they had won by luck alone.
